qa.install.title: Install DWBase component
qa.install.description: Provide the baseline DWBase runtime settings for this component.
qa.update.title: Update DWBase component
qa.remove.title: Remove DWBase component
qa.field.data_dir.label: Data directory
qa.field.data_dir.help: Filesystem path used for DWBase local storage.
qa.field.default_tenant.label: Default tenant
qa.field.default_tenant.help: Tenant identifier used when requests do not specify one.
qa.field.public_base_url.label: Public base URL
qa.field.public_base_url.help: Public HTTPS base URL allocated by Greentic ingress for this DWBase capability pack.
qa.field.public_path_prefix.label: Public path prefix
qa.field.public_path_prefix.help: Optional path prefix mounted under the public base URL. Defaults to /dwbase.
qa.field.nats_url.label: NATS URL
qa.field.nats_url.help: Optional NATS endpoint for swarm and replication features.
qa.field.swarm_enable.label: Enable swarm
qa.field.swarm_enable.help: Set to true to enable DWBase swarm replication.
qa.field.confirm_remove.label: Confirm removal
qa.field.confirm_remove.help: Set to true to allow component removal.
qa.error.required: One or more required fields are missing.
qa.error.invalid_data_dir: The DWBase data directory must not be empty.
qa.error.invalid_default_tenant: The default tenant must not be empty.
qa.error.invalid_public_base_url: public_base_url must be an absolute http:// or https:// URL.
qa.error.invalid_nats_url: nats_url must start with nats://, tls://, ws://, or wss://.
